background_story: Idris was a master potter from the Netherlands, renowned for his exquisite Delft blue ceramics. Born and raised in the city of Delft, he was fascinated by the traditional pottery techniques that had been passed down through generations. Idris spent years perfecting his craft, experimenting with intricate designs and glazes. His workshop became a hub for local artisans, where he shared his knowledge and skills. Idris's most famous creation was a stunning Delft blue vase, adorned with delicate windmills and tulips, which won him the prestigious Golden Potter's Wheel award. As his reputation grew, so did his passion for preserving the traditional Delft pottery techniques. Idris established a school to teach the next generation of potters, ensuring the art form would thrive for years to come.
